#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
#include <cctype>
#include <string>

class RMQ {
public:
    int n, k;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> min_val;

    RMQ(const std::vector<int>& a) {
        n = a.size();
        if (n == 0) {
            k = 0;
            return;
        }
        k = 0;
        int temp = n;
        while (temp > 1) {
            temp >>= 1;
            k++;
        }
        k++;
        min_val.resize(k, std::vector<int>(n));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            min_val[0][i] = a[i];
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j + (1 << (i - 1)) < n; j++) {
                min_val[i][j] = std::min(min_val[i-1][j], min_val[i-1][j + (1 << (i-1))]);
            }
        }
    }

    int min_range(int a, int b) {
        if (a > b) return INT_MAX;
        int z = 0;
        int len = b - a + 1;
        while ((1 << (z+1)) <= len) {
            z++;
        }
        return std::min(min_val[z][a], min_val[z][b - (1 << z) + 1]);
    }
};

class FastScanner {
private:
    std::istream& stream;
    char buf[1024];
    int curChar;
    int numChars;

public:
    FastScanner(std::istream& s) : stream(s), curChar(0), numChars(0) {
        buf[0] = '\0';
    }

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            stream.read(buf, sizeof(buf));
            numChars = stream.gcount();
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }

    bool isEndline(int c) {
        return c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == -1;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        std::string s = next();
        return std::stoi(s);
    }

    std::string next() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        std::string res;
        do {
            res += static_cast<char>(c);
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner in(std::cin);
    int n, k;
    in.nextInt();
    n = in.nextInt();
    k = in.nextInt();
    
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> segs(k, std::vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        segs[i][0] = in.nextInt();
        segs[i][1] = in.nextInt();
    }
    
    std::sort(segs.begin(), segs.end(), [](const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b) {
        return a[0] < b[0];
    });
    
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> finSeg;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ) {
        int lo = segs[i][0];
        int hi = segs[i][0];
        while (i < k && segs[i][0] <= hi) {
            hi = std::max(hi, segs[i][1]);
            i++;
        }
        finSeg.push_back({lo, hi});
        i--;
    }
    
    k = finSeg.size();
    segs.resize(k, std::vector<int>(2));
    std::vector<int> l(k), delt(k);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        segs[i][0] = finSeg[i][0];
        segs[i][1] = finSeg[i][1];
        l[i] = segs[i][1] - segs[i][0];
        delt[i] = (i < k - 1) ? segs[i+1][0] - segs[i][1] : 2 * n - segs[i][1];
    }
    
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>> dp(2, std::vector<std::vector<int>>(k + 1, std::vector<int>(2 * n + 1, 0)));
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n + 1; i++) {
        dp[0][k][i] = n;
        dp[1][k][i] = n;
    }
    dp[0][k][n] = 0;
    dp[1][k][n] = 0;
    
    std::vector<RMQ> rmq(2);
    rmq[0] = RMQ(dp[0][k]);
    rmq[1] = RMQ(dp[1][k]);
    
    for (int i = k - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
            int next0 = j + l[i] + delt[i];
            dp[0][i][j] = (next0 <= 2 * n) ? dp[0][i+1][next0] : n;
            dp[1][i][j] = dp[1][i+1][j];
            
            int upper1 = std::min(j + l[i], 2 * n);
            dp[0][i][j] = std::min(dp[0][i][j], 1 + rmq[1].min_range(j, upper1));
            
            if (j + delt[i] <= 2 * n) {
                int upper2 = std::min(j + l[i] + delt[i], 2 * n);
                dp[1][i][j] = std::min(dp[1][i][j], 1 + rmq[0].min_range(j + delt[i], upper2));
                dp[0][i][j] = std::min(dp[0][i][j], 2 + rmq[0].min_range(j + delt[i], upper2));
            }
            
            upper1 = std::min(j + l[i], 2 * n);
            dp[1][i][j] = std::min(dp[1][i][j], 2 + rmq[1].min_range(j, upper1));
        }
        rmq[0] = RMQ(dp[0][i]);
        rmq[1] = RMQ(dp[1][i]);
    }
    
    int ans = dp[1][0][0];
    if (ans == n) {
        std::cout << "Hungry" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "Full" << std::endl;
        std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    }
    
    return 0;
}
